response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS overall_rate FROM matched), pair_rates AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS pair_rate FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(pair_rate) AS mean_pair_rate, AVG(pair_rate - overall_rate) AS mean_excess FROM pair_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE pair_rate > overall_rate;
